guides.page: Money making guide/Buying construction materials from Bandit Duty Free
notes: Be skulled to trade with Noterazzo at Bandit Duty Free.
guides.review: Shop access requires a skull. The plugin cannot verify this state, so it stays a required manual check. Teleports remain optional; coins are cost inputs.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing Telos, the Warden
notes: Permanent access to Telos's chamber using an ancient sigil.
guides.review: The pinned guide requires tier 90+ weapon and armour. Initial chamber access needs an ancient sigil assembled through the four Heart generals; this is not a consumable item-ownership check after unlocking the door. No verified client unlock flag is available here, so access stays a manual check.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing adolescent white wolves
guides.review: The guide requires combat equipment but states no minimum tier. Keep this as an unchecked setup requirement rather than promoting the recommended level 30 skills to a hard minimum.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing the Giant Mimic
notes: A combat setup capable of defeating the beginner Giant Mimic within 2 minutes 30 seconds.
guides.review: A token is needed to fight and collect loot. The source gives level 30 as a recommendation, not an entry restriction. Keep suitability as a manual setup check rather than inventing a hard combat minimum.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing the Giant Mole (Free-to-play, Hard Mode)

additional_required.text: 41 Magic to cast Air Blast for this method

notes: A magic weapon and air runes for the described Air Blast setup.
guides.review: This specific method describes using Air Blast. Its spell requires Magic 41. Recommended Magic/Defence 70 and Prayer 43 remain recommended; no general boss-entry level is invented.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing the King Black Dragon
guides.review: The pinned Item field requires Rune +3 armour. The collected Rune platebody +3 bonus row confirms tier 53; the shared gear check accepts that tier or better. Recommended prayers and Combat 100 remain recommendations. This replaces the unquantified Rune +3 armour label, rather than adding a second copy of the same requirement. The Prayer 37 line explicitly says recommended and is retained in that section.

guides.page: Money making guide/Mining common gem rocks in Al Kharid mine

additional_required.text: 16 Mining for all gems included in this income table

guides.review: The guide requires a pickaxe. Rocks can be mined at level 1, but this method values jade and red topaz too, so its full output mix requires Mining 16. Mining 40 for a better pickaxe remains recommended.

notes: Armour for travelling through the Lava Maze.
guides.review: The source requires Armour without a tier; its icon is only an example. Do not turn the pictured rune platebody into a hard tier requirement. Muddy keys remain cost inputs, and the unquantified armour requirement stays manual.

The pinned guide explicitly states Skill None and Quest None. Wool is the priced input and the spinning wheel is a public workstation; the cash recommendation is not an unlock. This reviewed empty access list may pass.
